title: Clifford Calverly standing on one foot over the Whirlpool Rapids, Niagara, U.S.A (NYPL b11708197-G91F069 111F)
blurb: * Includes eight hand-colored views. Includes views by Alfred S. Campbell, C.W. Woodward, Strohmeyer & Wyman and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Some views offered as premiums by the American Cereal Co., in Pettijohn's Breakfast Food. Views of Niagara Falls: falls, rapids, islands, bridges, elevators, hotels, Terrepin Tower, winter scenes, railroads, fountains, parks, tourists and honeymooners.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.07% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.37% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
